# aether_cluster_network (Data Source)

The API-server network policy of a cluster. An empty `authorized_cidrs` list means the endpoint accepts every source address. A cluster whose policy was never configured reads an empty list, a null `api_server_rate_limit` (the platform default) and the zero time as `updated_at`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) UUID of the cluster.

### Read-Only

- `api_server_rate_limit` (Attributes) Connection rate limit on the API server; null when the platform default applies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_server_rate_limit))
- `authorized_cidrs` (List of String) Source CIDRs allowed to reach the API server; empty = every source.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC 3339); the zero time when never configured.

<a id="nestedatt--api_server_rate_limit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_server_rate_limit`

Read-Only:

- `burst` (Number) Burst allowance.
- `max_connections_per_second` (Number) Sustained new connections per second.
